GenAiFunction.description: Generates a comprehensive morning briefing for field sales reps. The Daily Brief is an AI-powered podcast-style update covering: (1) Quick Account Updates from CRM, PR Newswire, portal data, and ERP. (2) Inside the House - Company announcements. (3) Market Overview - Healthcare trends. (4) Clinical and Biologic Updates. (5) Med-Surg and Diagnostic Tech news. (6) Corporate and Strategic Moves. TRIGGER PHRASES: "give me my daily brief", "morning briefing", "daily brief", "morning rundown", "what do I need to know today", "catch me up", "market update", "start my day", "whats on my plate today", "what is happening in the industry". This action generates a comprehensive briefing without requiring specific input.
